purpose: Machine-readable evidence contract for Phase 5 #t58 external license service operations, SLA handoff, and key custody review.

required_configuration: JANUSGATE_LICENSE_VALIDATION_TOKEN is injected through environment or secret manager only
secret_handling: Record whether the service token is configured, but never record JANUSGATE_LICENSE_VALIDATION_TOKEN.
Record whether a license key was installed, but never record the license key value.
Do not store external authorization service responses when they include customer data.

required_configuration: JANUSGATE_LICENSE_SIGNING_SECRET is only used for HMAC deployments
JANUSGATE_LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY is public material for Ed25519 deployments
signing private keys stay outside JanusGate runtime
secret_handling: Do not print license key, signing secret, validation token, private key, or raw license payload.
Do not commit license key, signing secret, validation token, private key, or customer entitlement payload to Git.
For Ed25519, only the public key may be present in runtime configuration.
